defs: def row($coll; $key; $id): .config[$coll][] | select(.[$key] == $id); def source_of($trigger): row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; (row("triggers"; "trigger_id"; $trigger) | .source.event_source_id)); def workspace($binding; $collection; $prompt): . as $d | row("callback_bindings"; "binding_id"; $binding) as $b | $d | row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; $b.event_source_id) | .source_collection == $collection and ($d.assets[$prompt] | (contains("make worktree BRANCH=") | not) and (contains("Do not run `git commit`") or contains("Do not run git commit")));

jq.name: the pack keeps its categories and worktree-sized packages
jq.expr: (.scenario.expect.prompt_tool_contracts | length) == 6 and (.scenario.expect.result_documents | length) == 6 and (.scenario.default_prompt | contains("one shared branch and worktree")) and .scenario.seed.fields.area_count == "auto" and .scenario.seed.fields.history_depth == "250" and (.config.tasks | length) == 8 and ([.config.triggers[] | select(.trigger_id == "maintenance-execute-skip")] | length) == 1

jq.name: publish opens one normal PR and bounds review rounds
jq.expr: .assets["tasks/maintenance_publish_task/prompt.md"] | contains("one normal, non-draft PR") and contains("Bound this at two full review rounds") and (contains("make worktree BRANCH=") | not) and (test("--repo[ =]") | not)

jq.name: publish prompt watches the job key to a terminal state
jq.expr: .assets["tasks/maintenance_publish_task/prompt.md"] | contains("gents job watch") and contains("--until-terminal") and contains("wait_process") and contains("session_id:tool_call_id")

jq.name: watch command takes the whole job key, not an angle-bracket placeholder
jq.expr: .assets["tasks/maintenance_publish_task/prompt.md"] | contains("gents job watch KEY ") and contains("gents job watch trigger-session:abc123:call456 ") and contains("workflow result KEY") and (contains("gents job watch <key>") | not) and (contains("workflow result <key>") | not)

jq.name: publish prompt binds the watcher to the job's home and GraphQL endpoint
jq.expr: (.assets["tasks/maintenance_publish_task/prompt.md"] | contains("--home <job.orchestrator_home> --graphql <job.orchestrator_graphql>") and contains("`MaintenanceJob`") and (contains("<home>") | not) and (contains("<graphql>") | not)) and (.scenario.seed.fields | has("orchestrator_home") and has("orchestrator_graphql")) and (.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "maintenance-publish-tools") | .datastore.defra_query_collections | index("MaintenanceJob") != null) and (.scenario.expect.prompt_tool_contracts[] | select(.task_id == "maintenance-publish-task") | .required_query_collections | index("MaintenanceJob") != null)

jq.name: publish prompt reads the stored result
the publish Task has goal_objective_template and its Tools enable goal tools
the job block meets C5.11
jq.expr: .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "maintenance-publish-tools") | .integrations.plugins[] | select(.plugin == "gents/workflow") | .job | (.agent_targets | length) == 4 and (.dynamic_targets == null) and .policy.dynamic == "off" and .policy.trusted_packs == ["gents/code_review"] and .policy.project_roots == [] and .max_spawns == 128 and .max_wall_secs == 7200

jq.name: agents.target_ids equals job.agent_targets with enabled false
the execute workspace callback is bound and the worker may not commit
